refusal.message: controls/narrowing.feature:38: "an accepted transfer never loses acceptance when the amount is the same or larger" SAYS NOTHING: vacuous by narrowing. The clause is about accepted calls only (asked for by 'accepted' on the subject), and the second call is accepted too, and every accepted answer is in the class `accepted`: nothing can be lost. Its statement `Frames.Monotone (L.apply).successful L.largerAmount (fun ans => (L.apply).accepted ans)` holds of EVERY possible operation with these types and this notion of acceptance, whatever the code does (theorem Frames.Narrowed.monotone_holds, lean/Frames/Narrowing.lean), so no code can break the rule and it is refused
